Player.title: Player
Player.description: Authenticated player account profile, Naira (₦ NGN) balance, and match statistics.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

displayName.description: Player display handle shown in arenas and leaderboards.

avatar.description: URL of the player's avatar image.

balance.description: Current Naira (₦ NGN) balance held by the player.

lastDailyClaimAt.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last daily bonus claim.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player account was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest account update.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public non-PII ranking summary for real registered players.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

avatar.description: URL of the player's avatar image.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last ranking sync.

Room.title: Room
Room.description: Real-time multiplayer match room requiring a minimum of 2 real players, joinable from the lobby or via shareable invite link.

id.description: Unique room identifier used in invite links.

title.description: Room title displayed in the lobby.

gameType.description: Game mode played in this room.

hostId.description: UID of the player who created the room.

hostName.description: Display handle of the host player.

hostAvatar.description: Avatar URL of the host player.

playerIds.description: Ordered list of seated player UIDs (1 to maxPlayers, minimum 2 required to start).

playerProfiles.description: Map of seated player UIDs to display name and avatar.

minPlayers.description: Minimum players required before a match can start (2).

maxPlayers.description: Maximum players allowed in the room (2 to 6).

currentPlayers.description: Current number of seated players (1 to maxPlayers).

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the room.

visibility.description: Whether the room is open to anyone (public) or restricted to invited players (private).

inviteToken.description: Secret invite token required for private invite links (empty string for public rooms).

invitedHandles.description: Optional lowercase allowlist of invited player usernames or emails for private rooms (empty when anyone with the private link may join).

winnerId.description: UID of the match winner, 'tie' for draws, or empty string if undecided.

gameState.description: Live synchronized game board/hand state map.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest room or move update.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Immutable Naira (NGN) wallet deposit and withdrawal ledger record used for idempotency and wallet history.

id.description: Unique transaction reference (DEP_ deposit ref or WD_ withdrawal ref).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player who owns this transaction.

displayName.description: Player username recorded at the time of the withdrawal transaction.

amountNaira.description: Transaction amount in Nigerian Naira (NGN). Withdrawals are restricted to preset tiers (1700, 3500, 5300, 8000, 10700).

balanceAfter.description: Player's updated Naira (NGN) balance immediately after a withdrawal transaction.

status.description: Approval status of the transaction ('pending' on new withdrawals, 'approved' when approved in backend/Firebase, 'success' on wallet deposits).

bankName.description: Destination Nigerian bank name for withdrawal transactions.

accountName.description: Recipient account holder name entered for withdrawal transactions.

accountNumber.description: Full 10-digit Nigerian bank account number (NUBAN) for withdrawal payout.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was recorded.

/players/{userId}.description: Private player profile, wallet balance, and match stats owned strictly by the authenticated user.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Public non-PII leaderboard entries synced from real registered players.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Real-time multiplayer game rooms and invite-link matches.

/transactions/{txRef}.description: Immutable Naira wallet deposit and withdrawal ledger entries owned by the authenticated player.
